title: What Is Insurance Underwriting? How Insurers Assess Risk and Price Policies
description: Explore the actuarial underwriting process: risk assessment, medical exams, motor vehicle records, credit-based insurance scores, and underwriting risk tiers.
author: Elena Rostova

content.text: Insurance underwriting is the analytical process through which an [insurer](/learn/what-is-an-insurer) evaluates an applicant's risk exposure, decides whether to accept or decline the application, and determines the exact [premium](/learn/what-is-an-insurance-premium) required to cover the potential loss.

items: Medical Information Bureau (MIB): A centralized secure database tracking medical underwriting codes across life and health carriers to detect non-disclosures.
Motor Vehicle Records (MVR): Official state driving histories revealing speeding citations, DUIs, and at-fault accidents over the trailing 3 to 5 years.
Credit-Based Insurance Scores (CBIS): Actuarial studies prove a strong statistical correlation between credit management and insurance claim frequency (used across 85% of US states).
Comprehensive Loss Underwriting Exchange (C.L.U.E.): A 7-year historical database tracking every property and auto claim filed by a consumer or on a specific home address.

content.title: Actuarial Science in Underwriting
content.text: Underwriters do not make moral judgments; they evaluate statistical mortality and morbidity tables developed by institutions like the [Society of Actuaries (SOA)](https://www.soa.org/).

rows: Perfect blood biomarkers, non-smoker, clean family cardiovascular history
Minor cholesterol elevation or controlled mild blood pressure
Above average wellness, minor weight or cholesterol variances
Normal life expectancy, controlled common chronic conditions
Significant cardiovascular disease, diabetes, or cancer history

items.question: What is Accelerated Underwriting?
items.answer: A modern fintech underwriting method that uses algorithmic data analysis (prescription databases, electronic health records) to approve term life policies in minutes without requiring blood draws or physical medical exams.

content.text: Underwriting guidelines are filed with state departments of insurance to avoid discriminatory practices.
